recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12344 unless a future issue changes PractitionerRole endpoint search behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-12344 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Patient Administration change request raised in DSTU2 asking to add endpoint as a PractitionerRole search parameter so searches can include endpoint references.
initial_application: Jira says the issue was applied as a QA issue during STU3 publishing and comments point to broader tracker FHIR-12363. No commit explicitly names FHIR-12344, but git history shows 6b1a596ff193eb074b209f3e88c3d04fdaf158dd adding an endpoint/reference/PractitionerRole.endpoint search row during the STU3 era and 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carrying that definition into the current bundle search-parameter source format.
additional_context: FHIR-12363 is the broader same-change-family issue for Endpoint search/include support across PractitionerRole, Organization, Location, and HealthcareService and was decided opportunistically. source/fhir.ini marks PractitionerRole active, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/practitionerrole/bundle-PractitionerRole-search-params.xml already defines PractitionerRole-endpoint with code endpoint, type reference, and expression PractitionerRole.endpoint.

related_jiras.note: Broader Published/Persuasive ticket identified in FHIR-12344 comments that covers Endpoint search/include support across provider-directory resources.
